info.title: Prints API
info.description: The Prints API provides endpoints for managing print jobs, including generating, downloading, and retrieving the status of prints. It also allows users to fetch print configuration metadata.

servers.description: UAT server for corporate tax datasets
EMEA server for corporate tax datasets
APAC server for corporate tax datasets

post.description: This endpoint provides metadata related to print configurations, such as available sheets, print types, and print styles. Users can use this metadata to configure and customize their print jobs.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Authorization token required to authenticate and authorize the user.

requestBody.description: Payload containing the configuration request data in various formats.

200.description: Successfully retrieves the configuration data for prints.

post.description: This endpoint retrieves a list of print jobs based on the provided query parameters, such as offset and take. It allows users to filter and paginate through the list of prints associated with their account.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The starting point of the data set from which data will be fetched.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: The number of records to retrieve starting from the offset.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Required authorization token to access the endpoint.

requestBody.description: Request payload containing parameters for exporting print data.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create print jobs by submitting configuration details and calculations.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: The authorization token required for accessing this endpoint.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to download previously generated print jobs by providing the required print job identifiers.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: The authorization token required for accessing the download feature.

post.summary: This endpoint retrieves the status of generated prints.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to check the current status of previously generated print jobs.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Authorization token required to access this endpoint.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of the prints.
